name: io.github.adam121393/package-intel
description: Free, zero-config npm and PyPI package intelligence for coding agents: vulnerabilities (OSV), dependency graphs (deps.dev), download trends, and metadata. Check whether a dependency is safe, maintained, and current before adding it. No wallet or API key needed; an optional wallet unlocks consolidated health scores paid per call in USDC over x402.

environmentVariables.name: API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the paid API.

environmentVariables.name: NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: CAIP-2 network id for payments. eip155:8453 is Base mainnet.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave unset to use the free tools. Setting it to the private key of a wallet funded with USDC on NETWORK additionally unlocks package_health and package_batch_health, paid per call. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet: this is a hot key that spends automatically.
